entries.title: G3 battlecruiser (canceled)
entries.configuration: G3 principal arrangement checked against Admiralty NPD1255: two forward triple turrets, bridge, third triple turret amidships and machinery/funnels aft. Simplified external structures and secondary positions are original interpretations; this is not a facsimile of the Admiralty plan.

entries.title: Invincible class
entries.configuration: G3 principal arrangement checked against Admiralty NPD1255: two forward triple turrets, bridge, third triple turret amidships and machinery/funnels aft. Simplified external structures and secondary positions are original interpretations; this is not a facsimile of the Admiralty plan. The campaign Invincible variant adds its fitted stern catapult and AA; the two submerged torpedo tubes are internal and are not exposed deck mounts.

entries.title: Number 13 class (design study)
entries.configuration: Original interpretation of the game’s unbuilt Number 13 design study: four twin 18-inch turrets, fore-and-aft superfiring pairs and central machinery. The historical project had multiple design studies; this image does not claim a finalized historical arrangement. Hull proportions and small fittings are illustration choices.
